relationships.subject: NMTA
relationships.evidence_quote: we have identified NMTA as a highly selective TRPA1 agonist capable of alleviating inflammatory pain in mice through channel desensitization

relationships.subject: NMTA
relationships.evidence_quote: Oral administration of NMTA significantly alleviated pain hypersensitivity in Complete Freund's Adjuvant (CFA)-induced inflammatory pain in mice

key_findings: NMTA is a selective nonelectrophilic TRPA1 agonist (EC50 about 50 uM for hTRPA1) that desensitizes the channel on repeated application.
Oral NMTA alleviated CFA-induced inflammatory pain hypersensitivity in mice; T684 is critical for activation by docking.
